name: Hyperping
summary: Hyperping's free plan has 20 monitors at 5-minute checks and a basic status page. Paid plans cost $290 to $2,990 a year for 50 to 1,000 monitors, with checks every 30 or 20 seconds from 18 regions, phone alerts and on-call schedules.

evidence.capability: http and ping checks from many locations

facts.text: A failure is double-checked straight away from the other regions selected for that monitor.
Hyperping states that it does not hold SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certifications.
Hyperping says it holds customer data in Frankfurt, Germany, inside the EU.
Uptime data and logs are kept for 2 years.
The pricing FAQ says unused months of a yearly plan are refunded, while the terms say annual plans are non-refundable after 14 days.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 20 monitors at 5-minute checks, 1 basic status page, 1 seat

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: $29 on monthly billing. 50 monitors at 30-second checks, 3 seats, 20 SMS credits

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $89 on monthly billing. 250 monitors, 10 seats, 75 SMS credits, SAML sign-in

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $299 on monthly billing. 1,000 monitors at 20-second checks, 20 seats, 200 SMS credits

hiddenCosts: Extra seats cost $7 a month on Essentials, $9 on Pro and $12 on Business.
Single sign-on for status page visitors costs $49 or $99 a month per connection.

contract.cancellation: Cancellation takes effect at the end of the billing period. Monthly plans get no partial refunds, and annual plans are non-refundable after 14 days.
contract.dataExport: CSV export on Essentials and above, plus a reports API.
